whenToUse: A florist or gift shop with same-day delivery cut-offs, district fees, subscriptions and an order page.
Local delivery businesses where available dates depend on district and time.
avoidWhen: A general online store — use site-store-01.
a11y: Includes a skip link; cut-off and order changes use aria-live status regions; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Announce the remaining cut-off time as text, not only a ticking clock.
